architecture: freestanding bin od-acpi-blob (x86_64-unknown-none) puts a const-evaluated static in section .acpi_blob; packaging cuts the section out and reads the header, it never serializes; od-machine validates against the manifest hash of the resolved board

blob.payload_start: RSDP slot 0x40 bytes (empty until S4-31g), then DSDT, MCFG, 16-aligned, zero gaps
blob.manifest_hash_scheme: SHA-256("ODACPI-MANIFEST1" || 48-byte handoff device entries ordered by type code)

validator_rejects: foreign manifest hash (board without ECAM, board with NVMe, flipped hash bit)
payload outside [0xE_0000, 0xF_0000) (below, above, straddling the end, u64 overflow)
payload reaching into the NVS part
bad length (table header vs directory, past payload, shorter than SDT header, total_len, payload_len)
unexpected or repeated signature, signature mismatch
misaligned table or load base, table in the RSDP slot
non-zero RSDP address, non-zero reserved fields, non-zero gap bytes
handoff_default: byte for byte unchanged (golden handoff_block_is_byte_identical_to_the_reference, not edited)
